desc:
✨ Welcome to Sticky Hands Evolution!

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT: grab items for CANDY! Roll the pumpkin for 3 Halloween pets and the cauldron for 3 Halloween skills, like the 1% secret Ghost Hands! 

⏰ Your pets keep grabbing while you're offline, for up to 8 hours!

How to Play:
🧲 Grab items with your sticky hand
💰 Sell them for cash
🖐️ Evolve through 95 hands
🗺️ Unlock 26 zones across 2 worlds
🥚 Hatch pets that grab for you, even while you're offline!
⚡ Spin the Skill Machine for powerful skills like Thunderbolt and 1000 Hands
🔁 Rebirth for powerful perks

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

🎁 Use Codes: "UPDATE2", "UPDATE1", "Release!", "50LIKES","200LIKES" and "1000LIKES" inside the Shop! New code coming soon, it's gonna  be op
⭐ Favorite the game so you don't miss the next update!
